_comment: A8.2.1 WebsiteCreativeDirection conformance fixture — the ONE vocabulary + case set both packages/site-config (TypeScript) and apps/api app.domain.creative.website_direction (Pydantic) are tested against. Changing the contract means changing this file, and both suites must still agree.
